summary: Iteration 4 re-test after Dexie DataClone fix. All 4 previously-CRITICAL flows now PASS end-to-end with zero pageerrors. Note edit/save persists, wiki-link [[…]] insertion → suggestion accept → save → rendered <a.wikilink data-note-id> works and navigates, backlinks-panel populates [data-testid=incoming-{id}] on the destination note and outgoing-missing-0 is a <span> on missing links, BookmarkPageDetail Edit→Save updates h1+description and persists across reload. Smoke regressions (Cmd+K, INR finance + 4 tabs, Next steps add, Quick capture) all pass. The plain()/deep-clone fix in stores fully resolves the Vue reactive Proxy → IndexedDB structured-clone failure.

issues: Each incoming-link card concatenates the destination note's title with its body content as a single block of text (e.g. 'Reading list — winter (edited)- The Order of Time, Carlo Rovelli- Four Thousand Weeks...'). Should likely show only the title and maybe a short snippet, not the whole rendered body merged with the title. Not blocking; UX polish item.

action_items: (Optional polish) In NoteDetail backlinks-panel incoming entry, separate the title from the body preview so the card doesn't merge them into a single run-on string.
critical_code_review_comments: plain() = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(obj)) is the right pragmatic fix here; works because note/bookmark/page records are JSON-safe (no Dates, Maps, Functions). Confirmed all 8 stores now wrap .put with plain().

Stores still lack try/catch around db.<table>.put — if a future non-JSON-safe field is added (Date object, File, etc.) this will silently break the save with no user toast. Consider adding a generic error toast around store writes.

Test setup observation: BookmarkPageDetail uses [data-testid=page-edit/page-save/page-edit-card/page-edit-title/page-edit-desc] consistently — good. NoteDetail's title <input> in edit mode has no data-testid (only the body textarea does); minor testability gap — consider adding data-testid=note-title-input.
seed_data_creation: Built-in seed (2 notes: 'On slowness', 'Reading list — winter'; 2 loose bookmarks; INR finance data). Cleared IndexedDB before each scenario via indexedDB.databases() + deleteDatabase loop.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Vue reactive Proxy → Dexie DataClone bug is fully fixed via plain() wrapper in /app/frontend/src/db/index.js applied across all stores. All four critical flows (NoteDetail save, wiki-link E2E, backlinks-panel, BookmarkPageDetail save) verified passing in iteration 4. No retest needed for this fix. Minor polish item: incoming-link entries in backlinks-panel merge note title and body text without separator.
rca of the issue: Original RCA (iteration_3): Object.assign on a reactive store item and shallow-spread {...n} into db.<table>.put left nested arrays (e.g. tags) as Vue 3 reactive Proxies, which structured-clone (used by IndexedDB) rejects → minified DexieError2. Fix (iteration_4 verified): export plain(obj) = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(obj)) from /app/frontend/src/db/index.js and wrap every db.<table>.put(...) in stores (notes, bookmarks, tasks, projects, goals, years, areas, finance, nextSteps) with plain(...). Reproduction is now negative: open /#/notes/{id} → Edit → modify → Save → no pageerror, [data-testid=note-rendered] shows updated content, persists on reload.
